description: This ScienceDB deposit describes river-drainage density across China in one-kilometre grid cells for 2019. The China Land Surveying and Planning Institute and its data-centre partners extracted river centre lines from water-surface polygons in the Third National Land Survey before calculating grid density. The resulting spatial indicator can help characterise catchments, water-resource availability and erosion conditions around infrastructure. The repository offers the resource free under CC BY 4.0. Individual file formats were not established from the inspected landing-page metadata. Despite its title, the product describes river drainage and is not a municipal sewer or storm-drain inventory. Density also omits network connectivity and channel capacity. It can supply contextual covariates for flood-exposure or hydrological simulations, with additional terrain and discharge inputs. No directly related catalogue record was found.
